name: flin-search-console
description: Read Google Search Console performance and URL indexing status in Claude Code. Requires your own Google Desktop OAuth client.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID of your Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret for the same Desktop app OAuth client. Enter it here, never in chat.

default_site_url.title: Default Search Console property (optional)
default_site_url.description: An exact property identifier, for example sc-domain:example.com. Leave empty to choose per request.
